statement.body: One technology ecosystem: products and platforms we own and operate, digital solutions designed around the use case, and an AI layer we run — across many sectors, on an evidence-first method.
statement.identity: A global technology company and digital ecosystem
statement.identityBody: BuyTuk is not one platform and not a brochure site. It is an ecosystem that builds integrated products, platforms and digital solutions for many sectors and users.

whatIs.title: A technology company and digital ecosystem, not a brochure site
whatIs.body: BuyTuk builds and operates its own products and platforms, and designs digital solutions for industries. This platform you are reading runs on the same architecture we use in our products: one component system, an independent content layer, measurable performance budgets, and an explicit separation between live, in-development, research and concept work.

pillars.title: Owned products and platforms
pillars.body: Products and platforms BuyTuk builds and operates, each with a declared lifecycle state.

pillars.title: Solutions and digital capabilities

pillars.title: Applied technology

pillars.title: Evidence first
pillars.body: No project, number or client is presented as delivered before its documentation is attached.

readme.title: Honesty rule applied on this site
readme.body: Every product, metric and milestone on this site is flagged as Documented or Pending documentation. Anything not yet proven is rendered as a clearly marked placeholder instead of an unverifiable claim.

ecosystem.title: One ecosystem, many sectors
ecosystem.body: BuyTuk is an ecosystem of interlocking layers: owned products and platforms, an applied-AI layer, product engineering, technical infrastructure and an innovation lab — and those layers extend across many sectors by use case.

technology.title: The engine room
technology.body: Two layers, kept separate on purpose: the stack this delivered platform is built on (verifiable today), and BuyTuk's internal production architecture (awaiting client documentation).

disciplines.title: AI
disciplines.body: Applied models with human review in the loop, plus explicit separation of production, prototype and research.

disciplines.title: Cloud
disciplines.body: Deployable on edge and serverless platforms with managed caching and regional delivery.

disciplines.title: APIs
disciplines.body: Contract-first HTTP interfaces, validated payloads and typed content schemas.

disciplines.title: Automation
disciplines.body: Repetitive workflows converted into deterministic pipelines with observable output.

disciplines.title: Data
disciplines.body: Privacy-respecting event collection with a fixed, small event vocabulary.

disciplines.title: Web
disciplines.body: Semantic, accessible, server-rendered interfaces with performance budgets.

disciplines.title: Mobile
disciplines.body: Mobile-first interaction design, not a shrunken desktop layout.

disciplines.title: Infrastructure
disciplines.body: Static-first delivery, edge caching and immutable asset pipelines.

disciplines.title: Security
disciplines.body: Strict headers, CSP, input validation and server-side secrets only.

disciplines.title: Scalability
disciplines.body: Split content, presentation and delivery so each scales independently.

stack: Next.js App Router (server components, SSG + ISR)
React 18 + a token-driven CSS design system
Three.js / React Three Fiber, lazily initialised
Headless CMS content layer with committed JSON fallback
AVIF/WebP responsive images, font and code splitting
JSON-LD, sitemap, robots, hreflang, canonical URLs

academy.eyebrow: BuyTuk Academy — an example from the ecosystem
academy.title: Student → Teacher → School → Administration → Evidence → AI Assistance → Reports
academy.body: The education platform inside the ecosystem. It connects everyone in a learning institution to one evidence chain so decisions rest on recorded data rather than impressions — an example of BuyTuk's ability to build large digital systems.
academy.roleBody: AI in BuyTuk Academy is an assistant to teachers and institutions. It summarises, flags and prepares. It does not grade a child, replace a teacher, or make a pedagogical decision. The human role stays at the centre.
principles: The evidence chain is the product: every claim traces to a record.
AI output is always attributed and reviewable.
Teachers and institutions keep authority over pedagogical decisions.
Student data is minimised, scoped and access-controlled.
academy.positioningNote: BuyTuk Academy is a product/platform inside the BuyTuk ecosystem, and one of the strongest examples of what we can build. It is not the identity of the company, and not its only axis.

lab.title: Innovation Lab — a layer inside the ecosystem
lab.body: AI Lab and the Innovation Lab are technology capabilities within BuyTuk: where ideas and upcoming products are tested before they earn a place in the product register. Graduation is a decision, not an automatic outcome.

phases.title: Graduation

infrastructure.title: Built to be trusted
infrastructure.body: Security and performance are implementation requirements on this platform, not a later phase. The measures below are active in this codebase.

measures.title: Security headers
measures.body: Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff, strict referrer policy, HSTS and a locked-down Permissions-Policy on every response.

measures.title: Server-side secrets
measures.body: CMS tokens and integration keys are read from the server environment only. Nothing sensitive is shipped to the browser.

measures.title: Input validation
measures.body: Contact submissions are length- and type-checked on the client and re-validated on the server before anything is forwarded.

measures.title: Rate limiting
measures.body: The contact endpoint enforces a per-IP token bucket and a honeypot field against automated abuse.

measures.title: Dependency hygiene
measures.body: A deliberately small dependency surface and an npm audit step in the release checklist.

measures.title: Static-first delivery
measures.body: Pages are pre-rendered and edge-cached, with immutable caching for hashed assets.
